name: Esqueleto Explosivo 2
review:
The skeleton mariachis are back on five reels with 99 ways. Explosivo Wilds blow up nearby symbols, Mucho Multipliers rise with every drop, and dropping symbols keep the wins coming.

Medium volatility, 5,000x cap, 96.13% RTP. A lot more upside than the gentle original, while keeping the same catchy charm. One of Thunderkick's best-loved sequels.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
